auth.name: Name
auth.forgotPasswordDesc: Forgot your password? No problem. Just let us know your email address and we will email you a password reset link that will allow you to choose a new one.
auth.confirmPasswordDesc: This is a secure area of the application. Please confirm your password before continuing.
auth.verifyEmailDesc: Thanks for signing up! Before getting started, could you verify your email address by clicking on the link we just emailed to you? If you didn't receive the email, we will gladly send you another.
auth.verificationLinkSent: A new verification link has been sent to the email address you provided during registration.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.createDesc: Start an instant video conference or schedule an upcoming meeting with a shareable link.
dashboard.durationHint: Informational only; meetings do not cut off automatically.
dashboard.noUpcoming: No upcoming meetings scheduled. Choose Schedule for Later above to plan a future meeting.
dashboard.noRecent: No instant or past meetings found.
dashboard.deleteConfirm:
Delete meeting "{title}"?

Deleting this meeting will prevent any future access or token issuance.
dashboard.scheduleToggle: Schedule for specific date and time

meeting.tokenSecured: Token-Secured Access: This meeting session is authenticated using a room-scoped JWT issued by Meet-Ark. Anonymous direct access is blocked by the media server.
meeting.loadErrorHint: Ensure Jitsi services are running on {url}

profile.title: Profile
profile.infoDesc: Update your account's profile information and email address.
profile.clickToResend: Click here to re-send the verification email.
profile.verificationSent: A new verification link has been sent to your email address.
profile.updatePasswordDesc: Ensure your account is using a long, random password to stay secure.
profile.deleteAccountDesc: Once your account is deleted, all of its resources and data will be permanently deleted. Before deleting your account, please download any data or information that you wish to retain.
profile.deleteModalTitle: Are you sure you want to delete your account?
profile.deleteModalDesc: Once your account is deleted, all of its resources and data will be permanently deleted. Please enter your password to confirm you would like to permanently delete your account.

welcome.description: Meet-Ark delivers token-authenticated, privacy-preserving video conferencing with integrated scheduling, whiteboard collaboration, and low-latency WebRTC media.
